summary: Resolve the running or enabled systemd service during a staged namespace rename instead of treating an inactive linked unit as a conflicting install.

schema.detail: No database or client schema changes.

compatibility.detail: Manager-confirmed inactive linked units no longer conflict with running or enabled services. Both running or both enabled namespaces still conflict; unknown installed states remain conservative. Systemd observations request UnitFileState alongside load and process state; setup and uninstall integration fixtures model that property so conflict precedence and installed-unit errors remain covered. Worker authorization and process-generation validation are unchanged. launchd retains its existing running-before-installed preference.

downtime.detail: No coordinated service cutover is required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes; reverting requires no data migration.
